post.headline: Kwara law penalises landlords who skip the rent book
lines: A standard bank transfer or receipt is not the only paper Kwara demands.
In Kwara high-density areas, landlords must issue a prescribed rent book in addition to a receipt.
A Kwara landlord who fails to issue the rent book faces a ₦2,000 fine or three months imprisonment under s.32.
Keep proper paper for every tenant so your rentals stay strictly lawful.

short.title: Five clauses every tenancy agreement needs.
short.hook_say: Before you pay rent or sign any tenancy agreement, open the document and confirm these five core clauses exist right now.

tips.say: Your agreement must clearly state the exact rent amount and the precise dates the tenancy begins and ends.
Ensure the required quit notice is written plainly so neither side cuts statutory periods short when ending the lease.
Spell out who handles structural defects versus daily maintenance to prevent bitter arguments when pipes burst or roofs leak.
Name what damages the caution fee covers and the exact conditions for a refund when you pack out peacefully.

quiz.question: What penalty faces a landlord who skips the rent book in Kwara high-density areas?
quiz.explanation: ₦2,000 fine or up to three months imprisonment — s.32(3), Kwara Rent Control Law 1995.
